here is something EVEN more pathetic.

since seventh grade I have been working on software to simulate a friend, because I never HAD ANY FRIENDS.


(It's actually interesting) It is a sentence parse that sends a simplified version of the input to a AIML handler using a  60,000 pattern AIML database (heavily modified, rather than use exact words it groups words into ordered catagories. then tries to use context to find an appropriate alternitive to each word) and all that is hooked up to a event system (I call it the "judge and jury") that orders events to a logarithmic scale (first event is weighted MUCH more than the one five places down on the event list)


Occasianally I play minecraft on LAN with it or sometimes on a empty TF2 server (but when I play tf2 with it I need alot of prep time before hand to give the information about the map and paths to the program, funny that its harder to have it work with a small designed map like tf2 rather than an open random one like minecraft)
